workflows.name: AuthWire bounded retry network probe checks

implemented: Actor/revision/explicit operation acknowledgement and exact accepted-preview review binding.
One-off lease and RSA purpose-separated POLL/CLAIM/RESULT; replayed/concurrent CLAIM cannot return a second write grant.
Target, worker release and binding generation pins; lost authorization response holds a per-GPO uncertainty lock.
Separate rollback approval binds a completed stage journal and tree digest.
Idempotent outcome recording, bounded late interruption evidence, audit/state transaction atomicity and old-generation uncertainty retention.
Bounded 1MiB ledger, 32 durable job IDs and 128 transport nonces; no automatic job-ID pruning.
open_gates: Authenticated HTTP/panel review/create/status with both current permissions, session, Origin/CSRF and revision controls.
Bounded signed Windows claim/proof adapter, trusted path derivation, local durable job record and fresh AD/PDC/GPO/signature checks before filesystem stage/rollback.
Read-only journal reconciliation and separately authorized partial cleanup/resume/unblock; no DB-row deletion shortcut.
Strict backup transport projection before any live queue rollout; retain every approval/authorization/target/result in backup business data.
Signed customer delivery and real gMSA SMB stage/rollback acceptance; separate GPO activation and endpoint gates.
500/1000 scope collection/aggregation still open; batching must not duplicate the same physical GPO staging write.

forecast_review.reason: One source-only protocol sublayer is complete, but HTTP authorization, live Windows adapter, uncertain-outcome recovery, backup projection and customer acceptance remain. No elapsed calendar day was blindly subtracted and no new customer acceptance closed.
